body: MAINLINE-005b NFI-CRUSH filed, the next job CARD-005 named. On the brief's QUESTIONABLE p/2 core model, every P2 row (P2, P2-A, P2-C, P2-K, P2-E) needs 47730 Pa core compressive strength. Sourced real cores clear it from 20 kg/m3 up by ten times or more; the lowest passing density is about 11 kg/m3 in EPS on a 10%-strain definition, 18-22 on a 1% definition, and the incumbent 16 kg/m3 turns on that choice. MAINLINE-007 rows take the same formula when filed. Crush does not bind P2; buckling and face yield do.
